profile.headline: Full Stack Web and App Developer
profile.summary: I graduated as an Honors student from Boise State University and studied Games, Interactive Media and Mobile (GIMM). I just finished my year with Jesus Film's Animation team, where I worked in Unreal Engine 5 to make short films in Virtual Production. Before that, I spent almost 3 years as a React Native Full Stack Developer for GIMMWorks, working on mobile apps for the community and businesses around the country. I can't wait to use my skills like troubleshooting and teamwork to work with others on more projects in the future!

positions.title: Innovative Technology Intern
positions.description: Worked in Unreal Engine 5 to create a Virtual Production space from scratch for future short films. Also worked with a Rokoko motion capture suit to streamline 3D animation. Utilized my programming background often for creative problem solving, development, and teaching teammates new software and skills.
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · Virtual Reality (VR) · Unity · Troubleshooting · Virtual Production · Unreal Engine 5 · Problem Solving · Communication

positions.title: Student Software Developer
positions.description: Developed mobile apps, websites, and virtual reality applications for clients around the country focused around accessibility and innovation. Major project was a full stack React app that I helped scale up for multiple college campuses across the state. Collaborated daily with team members on projects using GitHub and actively met and communicated with clients to determine objectives, scope, user needs, and evaluate options to determine the best solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · C# · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Teamwork · 3D Modeling · Full-Stack Development · Scrum · Virtual Reality (VR) · REST APIs · GitHub · Unity · React Native · Troubleshooting · Problem Solving · React.js · Communication

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Improved existing pages that tracked various metrics internally and for clients. Created dynamic graphs and charts using D3.js and Vue.js.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Teamwork · Troubleshooting · Problem Solving · Vue.js · D3.js · Communication
